newsitem.title: USA: Packard Instrument collaborates with Glaxo.
newsitem.headline: Packard Instrument collaborates with Glaxo.

text.p: Packard Instrument Co said it is collaborating with Glaxo-Wellcome Plc on a system to make drug discovery faster, safer and more cost effective.

Packard, a supplier of instruments to drug and biotechnology companies, said Glaxo-Wellcome is the fifth major pharmaceutical company to adopt Discovery, a screening and analysis system to be used in finding new drugs.
The process is aimed at replacing older, conventional radioisotopic processes, which involve high waste-disposal costs, Packard said.

Packard said it is the only company to market the patented homogenous time resolved fluorescence chemistry from CIS Bio International of Gif-Sur-Yvette, France. The technology enables the screening of 50,000 samples per day, compared with 10,000 per day using conventional technology, Packard said.
